items.name: DKB-Girokonto
items.bedingung: Free with at least €700 in monthly incoming payments, or for account holders under 28
items.karteText: Visa debit card included; optional Visa credit card for €2.49/month
items.abhebung: Free from €50 per withdrawal at Visa ATMs in the eurozone; free worldwide for active accounts (≥ €700/month incoming)

items.name: ING Girokonto
items.bedingung: Free with at least €1,000 in monthly incoming payments, or for account holders under 28
items.karteText: Visa debit card included; optional girocard (fee stated inconsistently across sources, free per the conditions table)
items.abhebung: Free worldwide at Visa ATMs in the eurozone from €50 per withdrawal

items.name: Consorsbank Girokonto
items.bedingung: Free with at least €700 in monthly incoming payments, or for account holders under 31
items.karteText: Visa debit card included; Visa credit card available on request
items.abhebung: Free from €50 at Visa ATMs worldwide in euros (exact free allowances stated inconsistently across sources)

items.name: C24 Smart account
items.karteText: Mastercard debit card (physical and virtual); no real credit card
items.abhebung: 4×/month free (Mastercard ATMs in Germany/EEA plus participating retailers), then €2 per withdrawal

items.name: Trade Republic cash account
items.karteText: Visa debit card (Classic €5 or Mirror €50 one-time, virtual free) — no credit card, a pure cash account

items.name: N26 Standard
items.karteText: Virtual Mastercard debit card free; physical card one-time €10
items.abhebung: 2×/month free in Germany (then €2); provider states unlimited free withdrawals in the eurozone

items.name: comdirect Girokonto Aktiv
items.kontofuehrung: €0 for new customers for 36 months, then €0 if a condition is met, otherwise €4.90
items.bedingung: After the new-customer period, free with €700/month incoming, 3 mobile payments/month, or 1 trade/savings-plan execution in the comdirect Depot
items.karteText: Visa debit card included; Visa credit card free for new customers for 36 months
items.abhebung: 5×/month free worldwide with the Visa debit card, then €4.90 per withdrawal
items.einlagensicherung: Germany (assumed; not explicitly stated on the source page)

items.name: Openbank BestGiro
items.karteText: Visa debit card included; an additional credit card is stated as included free by the provider (exact network unclear)
items.abhebung: Free at around 3,200 CashPool ATMs in Germany; abroad 6×/month free, then €4.95

items.name: 1822direkt GiroDirekt
items.bedingung: Free from €700 monthly incoming payments or for account holders under 30
items.karteText: girocard (Sparkassen-Card) included; Visa Classic optional and chargeable (annual fee not stated on the source page)
items.abhebung: Unlimited free withdrawals at roughly 21,000 Sparkasse ATMs; 1% (min. €6) in the Maestro/Cirrus/V-PAY/Plus network; daily limit €1,000–2,000. Source states elsewhere, inconsistently, "free worldwide"
items.einlagensicherung: Germany (Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe institutional protection scheme; exact reimbursement amount not stated on source page)

items.name: norisbank Girokonto plus
items.bedingung: Source states no condition under which the account becomes free
items.karteText: girocard included free of charge; optional Mastercard direkt also stated as free
items.abhebung: Free domestically and abroad per the fee table; unlimited free withdrawals at Cash Group ATMs (Deutsche Bank, Postbank, Commerzbank, HypoVereinsbank); otherwise 1% (girocard) or 2.5% (Mastercard direkt), min. €6
items.einlagensicherung: Germany (no specific figure stated on source page)
